# Page-field auto-sizing recovery

These two original OPC/XML controls are generated by
`tools/shape_autofit_recovery_fixture.py`. No corpus content, native artwork,
font bytes or third-party rendering engine is used.

`unsupported.docx` has PAGE and SECTIONPAGES fields in auto-sized text boxes
before and after healthy content. Each box shares a group with healthy auto-sized
text. There is also a standalone healthy auto-sized drawing, a bold body/table,
and a NUMPAGES text box in the header. `matched.docx` differs only by replacing
`a:spAutoFit` with `a:noAutofit` on the three field-containing boxes.

At baseline `c0c27b00`, the unsupported source falls back to unstructured text:
zero decoded drawings and zero tables, compared with four and one in the matched
control. The field-sizing guard fires before normal layout.

Read-only recovery now retains each affected shape's saved dimensions and live
field text while fitting healthy siblings normally. It does not mutate source
paragraphs, assets or XML. The banner identifies each affected drawing/shape and
explains possible clipping and pagination differences. Editing remains disabled
and downloading returns the original bytes.

The approximation is deliberately limited to the known page-field auto-sizing
guard. Arbitrary measurement exceptions are not swallowed. Page-specific
auto-sizing, page-relative sizing combinations and other unsupported shapes
remain separate work. The matched control verifies the stated approximation;
it is **not** evidence of full auto-sizing fidelity against the native reference or a reference/spec divergence.

Unit checks preserve source package parts and identify three unchanged failing
frames plus three normally fitted healthy frames (two grow and one shrinks).
Browser controls compare complete page pixels and body/header geometry at 100%
and 75%, check all four decoded drawings and the table, and exercise read-only
input, the diagnostics banner and byte-identical download. Existing native
auto-sizing, group/geometry/spacing and page-field editing controls are required
regressions. Both sources pass the five applicable schema views, including WPS.

References: ECMA-376 Part 1 §21.1.2.1.4 (`spAutoFit`), §21.1.2.1.1 (`bodyPr`),
§A.4.1 (`CT_TextShapeAutofit`), §17.16 (fields), and the existing WPS subset in
`docs/conformance.md`. Saved-size recovery does not implement the missing sizing
semantics. No corpus entry is promoted by this control.

Local validation: 26 unit checks, 13 browser checks, both fixture packages and
29 browser-exported DOCX packages passed. Production build and license checks
passed. The existing build chunk-size warning is unchanged; no optimization
work or dependency changes are part of this fix. GitHub Actions stayed disabled.
